rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a torn shred or ragged piece of cloth.

example.english: I used a tatter to wipe the window, then threw it away.
example.traditional: 我用塊破布抹窗，抹完就掉咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 faai3 po3 bou3 maat3 coeng1 maat3 jyun4 zau6 diu6 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically when the tatter is an individual item of torn or ragged clothing rather than a piece of cloth.

example.english: They still wear that tatter everywhere and are not embarrassed at all.
example.traditional: 佢仲着住件爛衫周街行，真係唔怕醜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung6 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 laan6 saam1 zau1 gaai1 haang4 zan1 hai6 m4 paa3 cau2
